title: The low-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick fluctuation scale
main_claim: For the zero-field Gaussian SK model at every fixed beta>1, sd(log Z_n) = n^{1/6+o(1)} (Var = n^{1/3+o(1)}), and |F_n - E F_n| lies in [n^{1/6-eta}, n^{1/6+eta}] with probability tending to 1. The proof first gets a positive Laplace window c n^{20m} <= log E exp{s(F^c - EF^c)} <= C n^{100m} at s = n^{-1/6+5m}, then turns it into variance and typical-size bounds using a log-concave exponential augmentation.

issues.location: sections/cavity.tex, Proposition prop:cavity-closure (eq. 22) and sections/comparisons.tex, Proposition comp:conditional-error
issues.description: Not a demonstrated gap; this records what I could not check. The whole result rests on two things: the cubic one-site closure S = Gamma(K) + O(x^3), which feeds Lemma fl:low-mean, where a_L = C d^3/eps is exactly the size needed for the upper window; and the conditional comparison error bound of n^{10 delta} E per unit log lambda. Both come from long fixed-depth replica-cancellation and level-averaging arguments, about 1,200 and 600 lines. I read their statements and parts of the proofs but did not verify them line by line. Every downstream use I checked matches the stated hypotheses: x -> 0, W = O(x) at the omitted cut, and the direct-test inequalities d/a = n^{5m} and nE^2/(e(d)d^2) = n^{-10m}.
issues.evidence: "When W=O(x), the O(x^3) assertion also holds at every omitted lower cut, without a lower bound on its mass and without (4) at that cut." This is used in fl:low-mean to get S_u <= C d^3/eps.

coverage: Read in full: the introduction, fluctuations.tex (the final assembly), propagation.tex, companion-interface.tex, foundations.tex lines 1-340 (hierarchy, pressure formula, susceptibility and pinned-moment Brascamp-Lieb lemma), comparisons.tex lines 1-330 and 630-1000, and profile.tex lines 1-600. Checked by hand or with sympy: every exponent in the Laplace-window power ledger (lower bound eps*s^3 gives n^{20m}; upper terms -5/6+95m, +55m, +65m+delta, +25m); the chord lemma and its use in the lower comparison, the initial upper comparison and the wall-sweep endpoints (including the excess c_L cost); the wall-sweep envelope derivative (c_L/4)int[D^2+(S - r0 psi)^2]; the dyadic B-integral and log^3 bookkeeping; the log-concave augmentation, i.e. q(z) = e^{-z}E[e^F 1{F<=z}], gauge transitivity and Prekopa; the 1-D log-concave lemma constants (sqrt3/4 tail, M <= 2e^2/sigma); the final sigma bounds n^{1/6-5m} to n^{1/6+95m}; the child-data exponent inequalities (E' >= n^{delta/4}E, a' >= a, ceiling and floor of eq. 3); the depth N = ceil(10/delta) exhausting the E range; the c_p <= 1+p^2/3 induction; the Ito derivations of Gamma-hat' and Gamma-hat''; the limits A = T^3 a4^2 and B = 2T^2 a2^3; the gap contradiction g'(a1)+g'(a2) = A(a2-a1)^2/6 (sympy); g(0) = A l^3/3; the D^2 and Var L identities; and the u_*/a and d^3/(n^2E^3) gains in eq. 11. Not verified line by line: cavity.tex (row identity, projected replacements, finite-depth cancellation, calibration), comparisons.tex lines 330-630 (projection and raw-moment bootstrap), the rest of the proof of the conditional-error proposition, the macroscopic variational limit and uniqueness (profile.tex lines 600-913), and foundations.tex lines 340-861 (signed allocations, path limits).
